_comment: Evidence store for the CSRBT kit. Files here are CONTENT-ADDRESSED: the name carries the first 8 hex of the sha256 of the bytes, so a file that has been altered no longer matches its own name. sha256 is the identity; everything else in an entry is a claim about the file that tools/verify/verify_evidence.py re-derives from the bytes rather than trusting. self_certifying records whether the FILE proves its own origin (EXIF, GPS, timestamp) or whether the site attribution rests on testimony -- those are not the same evidence and must not read as if they were. An entry for a file the repository did not create MUST carry creator, credit and rights_holder: an evidence store that cannot say whose work a picture is has not recorded its provenance, it has only recorded its bytes.
